intro: Kodo Horns are sturdy natural reagents taken from the beasts that roam the northern reaches of the Barrens. To the Cenarion druids, their dense composition provides the necessary strength and potency for experimental herbal mixtures, most notably in crafting curative salves to treat poisoned wildlife.

p: While kodos are revered throughout the Barrens by the tauren for their endurance and strength, their horns carry practical medicinal value. Tonga Runetotem, working from the Crossroads, employs complete horns to reinforce the potency of his herbal remedies. Chips and fragments do not suffice for refining these salves; only intact horns gathered from the mature kodos wandering the arid plains hold enough strength to anchor the cure.
